leads.claim: When an activity log lets any reversible entry be undone in any order, make each inverse a compare-and-set against the value its write produced and refuse (rolling back the whole undo, with the reason) when a later write owns the field, because a blind inverse silently overwrites newer work and leaves the newer write's record counted as live.
leads.because: tidycrm: tidy a company then settle the domain, undo the tidy - the blind inverse put the pre-tidy value back over the settled name and the settle's revision still counted in the export summary; a compare-and-set on new_value plus a refusal fixed it (70d7708)
